entries.title: Titus 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, a bondservant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect and the acknowledgment of the truth which accords with godliness,

entries.title: Titus 1:2
segments: in hope of eternal life which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began,

entries.title: Titus 1:3
segments: but has in due time manifested His word through preaching, which was committed to me according to the commandment of God our Savior;

entries.title: Titus 1:4
segments: To Titus, a true son in [our] common faith: Grace, mercy, [and] peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

entries.title: Titus 1:5
segments: ¶For this reason I left you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking, and appoint elders in every city as I commanded you--

entries.title: Titus 1:6
segments: ¶if a man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of dissipation or insubordination.

entries.title: Titus 1:7
segments: For a bishop must be blameless, as a steward of God, not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for money,

entries.title: Titus 1:8
segments: but hospitable, a lover of what is good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled,

entries.title: Titus 1:9
segments: holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able, by sound doctrine, both to exhort and convict those who contradict.

entries.title: Titus 1:10
segments: For there are many insubordinate, both idle talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

entries.title: Titus 1:11
segments: whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole households, teaching things which they ought not, for the sake of dishonest gain.

entries.title: Titus 1:12
segments: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, "Cretans [are] always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons."

entries.title: Titus 1:13
segments: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

entries.title: Titus 1:14
segments: not giving heed to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn from the truth.

entries.title: Titus 1:15
segments: To the pure all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but even their mind and conscience are defiled.

entries.title: Titus 1:16
segments: They profess to know God, but in works they deny Him, being abominable, disobedient, and disqualified for every good work.
